batting.dismissal: c STR Binny b TG Southee

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c Ankit Sharma b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: KA Pollard
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b J Theron

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c AT Rayudu b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c J Suchith b MJ McClenaghan

batting.name: SPD Smith
batting.dismissal: c Harbhajan Singh b MJ McClenaghan

batting.name: KK Nair
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b MJ McClenaghan

batting.name: DJ Hooda
batting.dismissal: c UBT Chand b SL Malinga

batting.name: TG Southee
batting.dismissal: run out (KA Pollard, R Vinay Kumar)

balls.text: finishes it off in style with a four and gets his fifty too! Short of length ball with room, Rayudu cut it and made sure it went over short third man for four
in the air again as Rayudu doesn't middle that pull, but the ball falls short and wide of Smith at long on and they come back for two

Rajasthan have a consolatory wicket, that of Pollard! It was Theron's slower ball outside off, Pollard was eying the leg side again but only managed a top edge that went high towards Samson who caught it easily
shorter now, Pollard opens up and hammers it with a heave wide of deep backward square leg for four. Not from the middle but beat the fielder. The force this man has
full on the stumps, driven with a bit of power to deep midwicket. Only a single
135.5kph, Pollard heaves on the leg side and gets an inside edge to fine leg for one
another full toss, this one well outside off, and Rayudu gets to swing his arms with a drive over the covers right in the gap for four more
that's a juicy full toss, Rayudu gets under it and lofts it over the midwicket boundary into the crowd. RR not helping with the full tosses
low full toss outside off, drilled down to long on for one
pretty full outside off, driven down firmly to long off
back of length slower ball with width outside off, Rayudu waits and punches it over the covers and in the deep for four
he wants to scoop it fine on the leg side but Southee sends down a yorker well outside off, Rayudu gets only some bat on it
full toss number four of the over, this one around the knee roll and Pollard steers it wide of deep fine leg but the fielder slides to his left to save two crucial runs
this full toss is over the waist, Pollard manages to pull it awkwardly in the gap behind square for four more. Called a no ball
four fielders in the deep on leg but he pulls that short ball for six! He anticipated the short ball, opened up and hammered it over the cow corner to clear the boundary
too full outside off, Rayudu drives it into the covers for one
he delivers a yorker on the leg stump, Pollard digs it down to long on
low full toss around off, driven down easily to long off
full toss around the hips and that's a lollipop that had to be put away. Rayudu pulled it in the gap wide off deep midwicket for four
fullish outside off again, driven into the covers for one
that's gone to the second tier of Wankhede! He got the length delivery around off and lofted it down over long on with a lot of power. Massive six
full around off again, Pollard heaves it to leg, but not from the middle
pitched up on off, Pollard flicks it powerfully to the leg side between fine leg and deep square leg for two
sends this full delivery down the leg side for a wide
fuller on the stumps, driven down to long on for one
angled into the pads at good pace, Pollard can't get it away and takes it on the thigh pad for a leg bye
couple of short steps down the pitch and he drives it from outside off to sweeper cover for one
that goes down the leg side as the keeper spills the ball, not a wide as it went off the pad probably
flat and angled into the pads, helped along to fine leg off the back foot
some width outside off and he drives it to deep cover for one
Pollard also comes down and turns the ball to the leg side by closing the face of the bat
short and flat towards middle stump with some turn, Rayudu comes down and steers the ball to leg
a bouncer welcomes Pollard around middle stump and he ducks under it

that's a spectacular one-handed catch at short fine leg! Rohit went all across his stumps to expose them, got a full delivery outside off and tried to scoop it over short fine leg. But Ankit Sharma took a few steps back and stuck his left hand out over his head to grab it and let out a scream after that
hammered for six! That was way too short, poor delivery, Rohit put his left foot forward a bit and absolutely bludgeoned it over deep midwicket for a massive six!
114kph, the ball stops a bit and Rayudu defends it into the covers by checking his shot for one
angled in towards leg, tucked towards midwicket for one
not much room as the ball nips in, he gets an edge towards the slip region and says no for the single
too full, it's in his zone and slams it straight down the ground, over long on for six! Smith flew to his left from long, tried to throw the ball back in as he fell over but could not hold on to it
offcutter from back of lenth outside off, he tries to paddle it fine and gets a leg bye
tries to push the slower offcutter on the off side and misses
gets some room outside off, and he drives it authoritatively through the covers by leaning into it, head still, beautifully executed
in the block hole outside off, he shuffled across and then drove it through the covers
length delivery outside off, he drives it down to long off without much footwork
beats him! 131kph outside the off stump, Rohit pokes at it and misses
tries to slam the ball through the covers, doesn't middle it and gets a quick single to cover point
fullish around off, Rohit chips it in the air gently, it falls well short of mid off. No follow through on that shot
full on middle and leg stump, Rayudu flicks it to deep midwicket
angled in towards middle and leg, steered to the midwicket region for one
length delivery outside off, driven off the front foot to deep cover for one
comes down the track gently and drives the ball to long on
shorter and slower on middle stump, flicked with a forward lean to leg for one
pretty full on off stump, pushed down rather easily to long off
full on the pads now, he flicks it down the ground to long on easily
too full on the off stump, Rohit opens up and drills it wide of long off with a handsome drive, Nair goes to his left and cuts it to two
not much flighted outside off, Rayudu drives it down to long off
length delivery on the stumps, defends on the leg side
short ball to Rohit as well, he swivels on the back foot and pulls it fine by using the pace of the ball. He didn't put it too much power, just steered it fine on leg

smart catch from Binny! Unmukt has been bounced out. This was the reason Southee had been brought back, and he has provided it with a short ball that rose above the batsman's chest. The batsman didn't help himself by trying to drag the ball from outside off. Steepler heads towards mid-on, Binny tracks it well and takes it with the reverse cup
zips through Unmukt's open face as he looks for third man
goes wide of the crease and managed to get the outside edge. Perhaps played a bit inside the line that time as the fuller ball skews to third man
fullish, to befit the slip in place, but this delivery is slanted on the pads. Nudged through midwicket
flighted and full on middle, Chand makes room and drives it inside-out handsomely through the covers, all along the ground for four
Rohit drives extravagantly outside the off stump but missed the line and got a thick inside edge on the leg side, as the ball didn't turn
drifts it down the leg side, Rohit looks to sweep and it's a wide
length delivery on middle stump, Rohit blocks it back
fullish on middle, swept square and hard to deep midwicket for one
flighted and full outside off, driven down elegantly to long off

he appealed for it all alone, and got the umpire to raise his finger. The dangerous Simmons is gone! This one was much slower around the off stump, Simmons got into position early to paddle it fine and took it on the pad for a leg bye. Ankit appealed long and hard and the umpire took his time to raise the finger but did it eventually. Simmons took his eyes off the ball and got a big inside edge which the umpire didn't spot
nipping in a bit towards middle stump, Chand drives the ball square past backward point and gets two before Hooda cuts it off in the deep
width outside off for the fullish delivery, he swings his arms and gets an edge to third man
full delivery to follow the short ball, maybe he expected it and took a step down to hammer it to the long on boundary for six! No fielder in the deep there
just over midwicket! Simmons got the short ball, he doesn't miss those, and pulled that from the middle over the fielder in the ring for four
straighter length delivery on middle stump, Simmons defends it back
back of length outside the off stump, steered to backward point
flatter and straighter on middle, steered towards midwicket again but only one this time
that's clever batting - he tucked the ball towards midwicket with soft hands because the fielder is in the deep and they came back for two
too short this time, Simmons rocks back and pulls it with some power wide of long on in the gap for four
straighter on middle stump, Simmons goes back and pushes it back to the bowler
takes a step down but ends up defending the ball to leg
fullish outside off, Chand leans forward and drives to deep cover
back of length outside off, he guides it late to short third man but is sent back for the single
131kph, offcutter on middle stump, he pushes it down to mid on for a quick single
fullish towards middle and leg, driven down easily to long on
short ball at 127kph, pulls it late off the back foot to fine leg
fuller delivery on middle and leg, steered off the pads to deep midwicket again
starts with an offcutter towards the pads, clipped to the leg side for one
angled in from back of length towards the hips, tucked to deep midwicket for one
back of length towards middle stump, opens the face late to help it to point
angled into the pads, they want a leg bye as the ball deflects to point but Rahane doesn't get a direct hit at non-striker's end
tries the yorker, Chand gets an edge as he glances it to fine leg for one
full offcutter at 128kph, drives it square towards cover point
length delivery on the off stump, he guides it late to third man
welcomes Chand with a bouncer outside off, the batsman lets it go

that's a great reflex catch from Kulkarni, he's ecstatic after grabbing it with both hands! Parthiv slapped the ball from outside off straight back to the bowler who had to go low and catch it between his legs
short ball now around off, Simmons stays back and pulls towards deep midwicket for two
outside the off stump, driven straight to cover now
dances down and slams the ball just past mid on in the gap for four. He didn't middle that, but got enough to collect a boundary
nips it in a bit from just outside off on length, Simmons drives it down to mid on
straighter on the stumps, pushes it down solidly for a quick single
errs down the leg side for a wide now past the pads
slow offcutter, from back of length, Parthiv picks it and defends it late towards backward point for one
room offered again and Parthiv frees his arms with a slash outside off, between cover point and point again. Four more
touch fuller outside off, Parthiv looks to punch it through covers but gets a thick edge
that's short, there's width and Parthiv punches it off the back foot with a square cut to beat backward point and cover point for four
starts with a full, outswinging delivery outside off, Simmons drives it to third man past point
on the pads now, Parthiv move towards off and whips the ball late fine down the leg side to beat fine leg for four
142kph, on middle and leg and Parthiv tucks it straight to midwicket
short ball on middle, pulled straight to deep midwicket for one
fuller and shaping away, pushed off the back foot towards cover point
back of length outside off, Simmons defends off the back foot and takes a quick single towards cover. An overthrow makes it two
drives the full ball down the ground just past the bowler, they steal another single towards mid off

chance for a run out, Smith misses the stumps! Parthiv pushed the slower and fuller ball down towards mid off with soft hands and called for it early, Smith ran in from mid off but could not get a direct hit
width outside off again, he slaps it to cover point
edged over point and another four! The ball had good bounce and took the outside edge as Parthiv closed the face of the bat to the leg side, and the edge flew over point
superb back foot punch for four! Short of length delivery, Parthiv stayed back and slashed the ball through cover-point region for a powerful four
touch back of length around off with some inswing, Parthiv defends on leg with an inner edge
errs down the leg side past the pads and it's a wide. Samson spills the ball and they take a bye too
angled towards the pads, Simmons stays back and tucks it behind square on the leg side for two
beats Parthiv too! Southee pitched it up outside off, Parthiv leaned forward to drive and did it with firm hands but the ball moved away from him
angled in a little bit towards the stumps, he defends it on the leg side
no need to go back again, he charges down for the length delivery to take it on the full and smashes it to the long off boundary
beaten again as Southee swings the ball away from the batsman who went back to defend and couldn't get close to it
dropped on the second ball! Simmons edged it behind as the ball shaped away again, the ball was dipping on Samson, but he got to it and the ball came out of the gloves
nice shape to the ball, moving it away from length on off, Simmons stays back and defends
he takes a step down and swats the short of length delivery to deep midwicket for one. They fall short by eight runs
full delivery this time outside off, he wants to hammer it down the ground but doesn't middle it and gets a single

another full toss, in the air again and he's caught at long-on. This was definitely over the waist, and is called no-ball. Pollard doesn't realise that and throws the ball late, which makes Southee comes back for the second. But his throw is accurate and Vinay takes the bails off casually, catching Southee's bat short despite the dive. A no ball, a run, a run out
waist-high full toss, he pulls it in the gap to midwicket region and it's a one-bounce four. He wants it called a no-ball, but not declared
full on the stumps again, drills it down the ground and long on cuts it off
there's confusion, but no run out. Binny slammed the full delivery in the air to long on, he came back for the second, so did Southee and they both then went back in time
tries the yorker and Southee drives it down to long on
comes down the track and drives it to long-off for one
again in the block hole, Southee flicks and it goes wide of short fine leg as McClenaghan chases it
he opens up his stance and digs the full delivery out to deep cover for one
almost in the block hole outside leg, flicked behind square on leg for one
right on target on middle stump, pushed down to the right of cover for one

yes he tries a yorker and he gets a wicket! It wasn't 100% accurate but made Hooda lose his balance a bit, Hooda flicked it high in the air on leg, Pollard ran to his right, Chand to his left and took it comfortably
full and wide outside off, driven away from the body to deep cover for one

Parthiv appeals for caught behind, Mitch only turns around and asks a question and the finger goes up! Two in two! Back of length it is outside off, Nair swishes and misses. Maybe not, he got an outside edge

he's holed out to long-off, the crowd is ecstatic! It was full and outside off, from back in the crease Samson lofted it straight down to long off where Suchith didn't have to move much for this catch
how, how does he do that?! Another full toss outside off, this time he lofts it effortlessly as if he chipped it to cover. But that went all the way over the ropes. What timing!
full toss outside off, that was there to be struck, but he misses
full and wide outside off, driven to sweeper cover to rotate the strike
anticipates the yorker, he first comes down the track and then goes down on his knee to paddle the ball fine and up on the leg side for four! What adjustment, what audacity

smackalicious! Malinga rolled his fingers over that one, it was outside off and Samson, as if ready for it, hammered that over the midwicket boundary! The sound of bat hitting the ball from the middle, yes, that!
yorker-length again, driven down to long on for one

easy peasy run-out chance, Pollard misses it! Right in the block hole on the stumps, Samson digs it out to midwicket and Nair is halfway down the track. Pollard only had to collect and throw it easily to Malinga, but he misfields and runs over the ball
slow length delivery on leg stump, struck on the pads and they take a leg bye
slow offcutter outside off, tapped to third man for one
outside the off stump now, runs it to third man for one
103.5kph, what a shot! Slow bouncer and Samson jumps like Dinda in the crease and pulls it right in the gap, bisecting deep midwicket and long on as well as he could, for four
shuffles across the off stump, Vinay lands it short and slow outside off, and Samson flicks it gently to the leg side so that they can come back for two
cuts the ball late from outside off to third man for one
bit too short and Nair pulls it off the back foot right in the gap in the midwicket region for four on his first ball
back of length delivery outside off, Samson taps it late and fine on the off side. Malinga dives full length to his left and saves two

the pressure got to Smith, he's given a catch to third man! It was short and wide outside off, Smith threw his bat at it and got a top edge high towards third man. Harbhajan got under it nicely. Mitch pumps both his fists several times!
back of length actually and into the batsman and he steers it to leg, brings up his fifty
shuffles across this time and pulls the short of length ball to deep midwicket. Didn't middle that
three in a row! Outside off, short of length, Smith cuts with a horizontal bat and misses yet again
touch closer to the off stump and back of length, Smith cuts and misses again as Mitch gets good bounce
143kph, another swing and a miss as Smith swings his arms outside off and doesn't connect
full toss and way outside off, Smith chases and misses but it's a wide
clever shot, delicately played for four! It was well outside off and didn't turn much, Samson tapped the ball late and fine to beat short third man for four to make it nine from the over
comes down for the flat delivery and pushes to long on for one
goes on the back foot and steers the ball through midwicket in the gap for two quick runs
turns the ball from outside off to the leg side for one
very loud appeal for caught behind from Parthiv as Samson looked to tap the ball late outside off. Stifled appeal from Harbhajan, turned down
comes down to take it on the full and lofts it to long on, where Pollard takes it after a bounce
slow offcutter on the off stump, Smith goes across and whips it to the leg side for one
slow and full outside off, Samson taps it to third man for one
back of length now outside off, driven off the back foot to sweeper cover
114kph, slow offcutter around off, pushed into the covers
117.4kph, slower ball just outside off, Smith goes across and whips the ball square on the leg side for two
short of length outside off, guides it late to third man
uses his feet, Smith as usual, and drives the low full toss from well outside off through the covers for a beautiful four in the gap
fuller and slower on the stumps now, driven down to long on for one
straighter one outside off, Samson guides it late and delicately fine on the off side to beat short third man for four. 93.8kph it was
comes down, Harbhajan pitches it well outside off and Samson pushes it to cover
flatter on middle stump, pushed down to long on and that's the 100
sweeps the ball with the turn from off stump to deep backward square leg
takes a step down to make it a full toss on the pads and steers it to deep midwicket
slightly slow outside off, Smith cuts and bottom-edges it towards cover point
shorter on the off stump, he chips it over the bowler to long off
pitched up on the stumps, Samson goes down on a knee and slog-sweeps it to the midwicket boundary for a clean six. Not much turn from Suchith, so not much risk
comes down and towards off, and whips the ball with a big follow through to deep midwicket
charges down and heaves to leg with an edge
chops the ball off the back foot to deep point
loopy delivery on the off stump, Smith comes down and takes it as a full toss to whip it to deep midwicket
fullish on the off stump, drive down to long on easily for one
makes more room this time, think it was a straighter one and Samson cut it past point for two
goes back and exposes his stumps a bit, tucks the ball to midwicket
beaten outside off! Samson looked to defend on the front foot but it beat the outside edge
that's too short and it gives Smith enough time to pivot on his back foot and pull it with the angle just behind square on the leg side for four
leans forward for the ball outside off, but on the wrong line and inside edge goes to short fine leg. Samson would have been in trouble if Malinga got a direct hit at bowler's end
room outside off again, Smith punches it down to long off for one
bit of flight and way outside off for a wide
slightly slower outside off, he guides it very late to beat short third man and Harbhajan runs to the boundary to slide and save one
uses his feet immediately and drives it down to long off

86.5kmh, Watson was struggling against Suchith a little bit and he's bowled! He went back in the crease an exposed his stumps, wanted to cut the ball from off stump but it hurried on to him and knocked the off stump over
goes down on a knee and sweeps it from the middle of the bat, with the turn, wide of deep midwicket for a one-bounce four
goes back in the crease and clips the ball to deep midwicket for one
helps the ball with the turn to deep midwicket for one
leans towards the ball and tucks the ball to square leg. Rohit runs in vigorously from midwicket
sweeps the ball with the turn wide of deep backward square leg, McClenaghan does good work in the deep as they come back for two
turning towards leg stump now, Samson leans forward and lobs the ball towards short leg
starts by turning the ball down leg for a wide
just outside off, Watson opens up and punches it back to the bowler again
slower around off stump, Samson goes back and tucks the ball to deep midwicket now
flighted on off, it's full too and Samson flicks it uppishly through the midwicket region. Pollard runs across from long on and slides to save two
cross-batted shot for the length ball on off, just clears midwicket for one
outside the off stump now, he cuts off the back foot to point
punches the short of length ball back to the bowler
that's flat and way down the leg side for a wide, even Parthiv coudln't get to it
length delivery outside off, he leans forward to defend it on off
full on leg, Watson flicks it off the pads uppishly and Suchith runs to his right from deep midwicket very quickly
tad closer to off stump, he guides it late to third man for one
hops in the crease for the back of length ball and punches it straight down to mid off
goes across a bit again and pushes the ball to cover point this time
going down the leg side, Samson shuffles across and manages to get some bat on it as he helps it fine down leg for four. Fine leg is in the circle
good reply by Watson after four dot balls. Gets another short delivery and he swat-pulls it behind square on the leg side this time in the gap, four runs
that's too short now and Watson middles it this time. He goes back and powers it to the midwicket boundary with a pull for six
fourth dot ball in a row as Watson goes back to pull the short ball but it hurried on to him. Inside edge on the pads
slams it back to the bowler from off stump, Suchith stops it with both hands
flighted length delivery chasing Watson as he makes room, steered to square leg
on middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler

run out chance at non-striker's end, Watson dives, it's a direct hit and the decision goes upstairs! Samson tucked the ball towards midwicket and sent Watson back, he had to dive in and made it in even as Suchith hit the stumps. Not out and the ball goes for four overthrows
touch back of length outside off, pushed to cover point off the back foot
length delivery on the pads now, clipped to deep midwicket easily for one
leans forward and pushes the outswinger into the coves
outswing for the short of length ball, Watson waits and then drives it square beautifully on the off side betwen cover point and point for a four

gets a wicket first ball, a scratchy-looking Rahane is gone! He came down the track and made room, swished at it from around off stump and the ball went very high on the off side. Cover and cover point both ran back from their positions and Rayudu took it successfully. Wasn't an easy catch
loud appeal for lbw with the change of pace, it hit Rahane in front of the stumps as he shuffled across. Turned down probably because it pitched outside leg
back of length on middle and off, Watson opens up and swivels the bat to turn the ball to leg
short ball towards the hips, Rahane has no room and gets a run square of the wicket
on length on the middle stump now, Watson defends to the leg side and sneaks in one
that's even shorter as Mitch bangs it in, the bouncer goes well over Watson and it's called a wide
that's short and angled across, Watson pivots on the back foot and smacks it with a pull to the cow corner boundary from the middle of the bat
another outside edge as Rahane drives away from the body and it flies away towards third man
back of a length and outside off, slid away to third man

fullish on and around off stump, but Rahane doesn't care. Supple wrists come down on the ball, roll a little to give it direction and he gets a boundary through midwicket. Risky, but wonderfully executed
jags the ball away off the pitch and Rahane goes for a tentative poke. Easily beaten
appeared the slower yorker, but Rahane has seen it well and clips it to long leg. And the throw is way wild. He was running beside the pitch on the off side, and yet he had to duck
good length on middle, nudged to midwicket
another outside edge for Rahane, who was looking for a clip through the midwicket region and has to settle for a skew to third man
shortish and outside off, Watson goes for a flash. Can't connect

drops a sitter! Rahane doesn't learn from his last swipe. Goes for another one - went after the ball way too early - gets a top edge that should have gone right down square leg's throat. It does, but then goes through his hands as well. J Suchith is the culprit
huge slog and he secures an inside edge to the fine leg boundary. Could easily have toppled his leg stump. Good length on off nearly did him
second wide of the over. McClenaghan does have that tendancy to be wayward, when he isn't confident enough in himself. Mumbai are playing after five days
taps to the right of mid-on to get off the mark as Mitch keeps it shortish
back of a length and pushed a little too far outside off to interest the batsman
a little too tight on middle and leg, clipped to the left of long leg
back of a length, slipping away down leg. And so does he - loses his footing in his followthrough and falls face first onto the pitch
